responsibility: Implements generation of a SWIG interface file for exported symbols of the main Modula-2 module. It collects exported procedures and variables, resolves dependency ordering for referenced types, emits `%module`, exception boilerplate, C declarations, parameter annotations for VAR and unbounded-array arguments, and `%array_functions`/`%apply` directives where needed, producing a `.i` file that mirrors the module’s exported API in a SWIG-friendly C view.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for the M2Swig pair: it gathers exported procedures and variables, orders dependent types, handles unbounded-array and VAR-parameter annotations, and writes the `%module`, `%include`, C declarations, and SWIG directives to the `.i` file. Unlike `M2Swig.def`, it contains the actual interface-generation engine.
